title: Signalling Welcome Message
description: Sent by the signalling server after a client connects. Provides the connection ID and ICE server configuration (STUN + optional TURN credentials).

connectionId.description: Unique identifier assigned to this connection by the signalling server.

iceServers.description: ICE server configuration to be used for WebRTC peer connection setup. Includes STUN and optionally TURN relay servers with short-lived credentials.

urls.description: One or more STUN/TURN URLs for this server.

username.description: Username for TURN authentication. Not required for STUN servers.

credential.description: Credential for TURN authentication. Not required for STUN servers.
